summary: The lord of expenditure on the lagna: classical and modern sources see high spending and a thin constitution or resources, while Braha, Raman and Frawley also see an ascetic, spiritual or travelling disposition.
common_outcomes: extravagant; lacks wealth and learning (BPHS 24.133)
a weak constitution, yet handsome and sweet-tongued (Raman HTJH)
constant travelling if the lagna is a common sign (Raman HTJH)
an ascetic or spiritual nature; travel for spiritual purposes (Braha)
Rath: loss of health is shown (Crux 15.10); a traditional line, never a medical claim
rare_outcomes: BPHS 24.133 speaks of physical weakness and phlegm-related trouble; do not use as a health prediction
BPHS 23.14: with the lagna lord in the 12th and the 12th lord in the lagna joined with Venus, expenditure on dharmic matters
exchange of the lagna and 12th lords: miserly and disliked (Raman HTJH); contrast BPHS 23.14
the placement can also indicate living abroad or confinement (Raman HTJH); traditional
Frawley (Example Charts: Paramahansa Yogananda, Gemini lagna): the Moon as 12th lord in the 1st shows a capacity for noble self-negation

by_area.personality: Feeble-minded yet handsome and sweet-tongued (Raman HTJH); ascetic or spiritual (Braha); noble self-negation (Frawley, Yogananda chart).
by_area.finance: Extravagant and lacking wealth (BPHS 24.133); in the 12th lord's period with the lagna lord, wealth lost through short-sighted schemes (Raman HTJH, periods).
by_area.health: Physical weakness is a traditional line (BPHS 24.133; Raman HTJH; Braha; Rath Crux 15.10); never use as a medical prediction.
by_area.relationships: Bad for married life, as the 12th lord aspects the 7th (Braha).
by_area.spirituality: Ascetic or spiritual nature; travel for spiritual purposes (Braha).

strengtheners: 12th lord with benefics, in own sign or exalted (BPHS 23.1 lists these as the good condition of the 12th lord)
a benefic 12th lord reduces the evil (Raman HTJH, periods)
exchange with the lagna lord plus Venus turns spending towards dharma (BPHS 23.14)
weakeners_or_cancellations: exchange with the lagna lord without Venus: miserliness (Raman HTJH)
malefic, debilitated or combust company of the 12th lord: questionable spending (Raman HTJH, general combinations)
lagna_or_context_notes: For Aquarius lagna Saturn owns both the 1st and 12th and is in its own sign here; Frawley (pp. 159-160) says the lagna lord is always generally auspicious and a 12th lordship mainly gives the other house's results, so the lagna role dominates.

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 24.133
source_views.view: Extravagant, physically weak, phlegm-related trouble, lacks wealth and learning.

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 23.1, 23.14
source_views.view: 12th lord with benefics, own sign or exaltation is favourable; lagna lord in the 12th and 12th lord in the lagna with Venus: spending on dharma.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XVI 'Results of the Lord of the Twelfth House being Posited in Different Houses'
source_views.view: Weak constitution and feeble-minded, yet handsome and sweet-tongued; travels if in a common sign; with the 6th lord, long life unless the 8th is afflicted; can show confinement and living abroad; a lagna-12th exchange makes one miserly and disliked.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XVI 'Time of Fructification' (12th-lord periods with the lord of the house occupied)
source_views.view: 12th lord in the lagna with the lagna lord: in its period, loss of affection, dull intellect, miserliness and loss of wealth through short-sighted schemes; a benefic 12th lord reduces the evil.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer, '12th House' chapter, 'The ruler of the 12th house placed in the' houses
source_views.view: Poor health and appearance, little confidence, an unhappy start; an ascetic or spiritual nature, travel for spiritual purposes; bad for married life as the 12th lord aspects the 7th.

source_views.source: David Frawley, The Astrology of the Seers, Example Charts: Paramahansa Yogananda
source_views.view: The Moon in the 1st as lord of the 12th house of loss and negation shows a capacity for noble self-negation.

source_views.source: Sanjay Rath, Crux of Vedic Astrology: Timing of Events, 15.10 (the twelfth lord)
source_views.view: The 12th lord causes losses and grief to the house it occupies (in the 1st, loss of health; in the 2nd, loss of wealth). In a dusthana, especially with a dusthana lord or natural malefic, it causes Vipareeta Raja yoga; joined with a natural benefic or yogakaraka it gives Raja yoga in its period if linked to the 10th in the dasamsa.

source_views.source: David Frawley, The Astrology of the Seers, ch. 'The Houses: The Domains of Planetary Action', 'Dual House Rulership', pp. 159-160
source_views.view: The 12th lordship mainly gives the effect of the other house the planet rules (Venus as 5th+12th lord for Gemini is very auspicious); its negative effect shows most when the other house is also malefic (Saturn as 11th+12th lord for Pisces is very inauspicious). The lagna lord is always generally auspicious despite a second malefic lordship.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri) 16.30
source_views.view: Note the bhava occupied by the 12th lord and the bhava owned by any planet in the 12th: loss of things connected with those bhavas should be predicted.

disagreements: BPHS, Raman, Braha and Rath are negative on body and resources; Braha, Raman and Frawley's Yogananda example add a spiritual or ascetic side. Raman reads a lagna-12th exchange as miserly, while BPHS 23.14 with Venus turns it to dharmic spending.
phrasing_guidance: Describe a reflective, generous nature and a need to manage spending. Never mention bodily weakness or illness as a prediction.

summary: The lord of expenditure in the house of wealth and speech: BPHS says spending goes to auspicious acts and the person is sweet-spoken and virtuous, while Raman, Braha and Rath predict financial losses unless the 12th lord is a dignified benefic.
common_outcomes: spends on auspicious acts; righteous, pleasant speech, good qualities (BPHS 24.134)
financial losses and possible debts (Raman HTJH; Braha; Rath Crux 15.10)
irregular meals and weak eyesight (Raman HTJH; Braha); traditional lines
family life lacking harmony (Raman HTJH; Braha)
rare_outcomes: a benefic 12th lord in dignity greatly reduces the evil and gives financial stability and tactful speech (Raman HTJH)
the 2nd lord in the 12th with the 12th lord in the 2nd (exchange) is a yoga for poverty (Frawley p. 179)
with the 2nd lord here: family bickering in the 12th lord's period, much reduced if the lord is favourably disposed (Raman HTJH, periods)

by_area.personality: Gentle-spoken and good-natured (BPHS 24.134); tactful if the lord is a dignified benefic, given to gossip if ill-disposed (Raman HTJH).
by_area.finance: BPHS gives spending on auspicious acts; Raman, Braha and Rath give losses and debts.
by_area.family: Lack of family harmony (Raman HTJH; Braha).

strengtheners: a benefic 12th lord in dignity (Raman HTJH); benefic association, own sign or exaltation (BPHS 23.1)
12th lord in benefic vargas: spending on approved objects (JP 15.75)
weakeners_or_cancellations: exchange with the 2nd lord: a poverty yoga (Frawley p. 179)
an ill-disposed 12th lord: gossip and quarrelling (Raman HTJH)
lagna_or_context_notes: For Gemini lagna Venus (5th+12th) is here in Cancer; Frawley (p. 159) calls Venus for Gemini very auspicious, giving mainly 5th-house results. For Cancer lagna Mercury (3rd+12th) is here in Leo. Results scale with strength (BPHS 24.145-148).

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 24.134
source_views.view: Spends on auspicious acts, righteous, pleasant speech, good qualities.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XVI 'Results of the Lord of the Twelfth House being Posited in Different Houses'
source_views.view: Financial losses, debts, irregular meals, poor eyesight, family discord; a benefic 12th lord in dignity greatly reduces this and gives financial stability and tactful speech; ill-disposed, gossip and quarrels.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XVI 'Time of Fructification' (12th-lord periods with the lord of the house occupied)
source_views.view: With the 2nd lord: domestic bickering, poor food, ill temper in the 12th lord's period; much reduced if the 12th lord is favourably disposed.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer, '12th House' chapter, 'The ruler of the 12th house placed in the' houses
source_views.view: Poor, financial losses, unhappy family life, foul language, poor right-eye vision, bad food, a poor speaker.

source_views.source: David Frawley, The Astrology of the Seers, ch. 'Planetary Aspects and Combinations', p. 179
source_views.view: If the 2nd lord is in the 12th and the 12th lord in the 2nd, this is a yoga for poverty.

source_views.source: Sanjay Rath, Crux of Vedic Astrology: Timing of Events, 15.10 (the twelfth lord)
source_views.view: The 12th lord causes losses and grief to the house it occupies (in the 1st, loss of health; in the 2nd, loss of wealth). In a dusthana, especially with a dusthana lord or natural malefic, it causes Vipareeta Raja yoga; joined with a natural benefic or yogakaraka it gives Raja yoga in its period if linked to the 10th in the dasamsa.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata (Vaidyanatha; tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, Vol. II) XV.75
source_views.view: If the 12th lord occupies benefic vargas, all outlay is on approved, legitimate objects; with or aspected by a weak planet, the outlay is questionable.

source_views.source: David Frawley, The Astrology of the Seers, ch. 'The Houses: The Domains of Planetary Action', 'Dual House Rulership', pp. 159-160
source_views.view: The 12th lordship mainly gives the effect of the other house the planet rules (Venus as 5th+12th lord for Gemini is very auspicious); its negative effect shows most when the other house is also malefic (Saturn as 11th+12th lord for Pisces is very inauspicious). The lagna lord is always generally auspicious despite a second malefic lordship.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri) 16.30
source_views.view: Note the bhava occupied by the 12th lord and the bhava owned by any planet in the 12th: loss of things connected with those bhavas should be predicted.

disagreements: Sharp: BPHS 24.134 is favourable in character and channels spending to good acts, while Raman, Braha and Rath predict financial losses. Raman partly reconciles them: a dignified benefic 12th lord gives financial stability.
phrasing_guidance: Speak of kindness in speech and generous giving; suggest mindful saving.

summary: The lord of loss in the house of siblings and effort: BPHS says sibling happiness is limited and the person may be at odds with others and focused on self-care.
common_outcomes: lacks sibling happiness, hostile to others, attentive to own body (BPHS 24.135)
timid and quiet; spends on younger siblings (Raman HTJH)
little success as a writer; a commonplace job (Raman HTJH); no literary ability (Braha)
strong intuition (Braha)
rare_outcomes: with the 2nd lord here and Jupiter or the 9th lord aspecting: more than one marriage (Raman HTJH)
with the 3rd lord: mounting expenditure and many journeys in the period; joined instead with the 6th and 8th lords, good food, riches and luxuries (Raman HTJH, periods)
malefic affliction: ear trouble (Raman HTJH; Braha); a traditional line only

by_area.personality: Timid and quiet (Raman HTJH); hostile to others (BPHS 24.135); intuitive (Braha).
by_area.career: Commonplace work; unsuccessful as a writer (Raman HTJH).

strengtheners: benefic association, own sign or exaltation (BPHS 23.1)
the 12th lord in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the navamsa lagna, or aspected by benefics, reverses the bad results (Raman HTJH, periods)
lagna_or_context_notes: For Capricorn lagna Jupiter owns the 3rd and 12th and is in Pisces, own sign, here.

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 24.135
source_views.view: Lacks sibling happiness, hostile to others, attentive to own body.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XVI 'Results of the Lord of the Twelfth House being Posited in Different Houses'
source_views.view: Timid and quiet, loss of a brother, shabbily dressed, ear trouble if afflicted, spends on younger brothers, an unsuccessful writer in a commonplace job; with the 2nd lord here and Jupiter or the 9th lord aspecting, more than one wife.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XVI 'Time of Fructification' (12th-lord periods with the lord of the house occupied)
source_views.view: With the 3rd lord: brothers face hardship and expenses mount; contrary results if in the 6th/8th/12th navamsa or aspected by benefics; many journeys; combined with the 6th and 8th lords, riches and luxuries.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer, '12th House' chapter, 'The ruler of the 12th house placed in the' houses
source_views.view: No happiness from siblings, unfulfilled desires, no literary or artistic talent, fearful, unsuccessful efforts; yet strong intuition. Rule list: the 12th lord in the 3rd gives enormous intuition.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri) 16.30
source_views.view: Note the bhava occupied by the 12th lord and the bhava owned by any planet in the 12th: loss of things connected with those bhavas should be predicted.

disagreements: BPHS, Raman and Braha agree on little sibling happiness and weak efforts; Braha alone adds strong intuition.
phrasing_guidance: Mention possible distance from siblings without implying conflict is fated. Encourage communication.

summary: The lord of loss in the house of home and mother: BPHS, Raman and Braha see little happiness from the mother and losses around land, vehicles and houses; Raman adds living abroad and Braha a strong spiritual pull.
common_outcomes: little happiness from the mother; daily losses concerning land, vehicles and houses (BPHS 24.136)
mental restlessness, enmity of relatives and living abroad (Raman HTJH)
an ordinary residence and trouble from landlords (Raman HTJH); few fixed assets, car problems (Braha)
a strong spiritual nature: a moksha lord in a moksha house (Braha)
rare_outcomes: a well-placed 12th lord mitigates much of this (Raman HTJH)
rents out part of the home or buys houses to rent (Braha)
many career changes, as the 12th lord aspects the 10th (Braha)
with the 4th lord and benefics: substantial property and growing interest in spiritual literature (Raman HTJH, periods)

by_area.finance: Losses on land, vehicles and houses (BPHS 24.136; Braha).
by_area.family: Little happiness from the mother (BPHS 24.136; Braha); enmity of relatives (Raman HTJH).

strengtheners: benefic association, own sign or exaltation (BPHS 23.1); a well-placed 12th lord (Raman HTJH)
a strong Venus: own conveyance, though it gives trouble (Raman HTJH)
weakeners_or_cancellations: malefic affliction of the 12th lord: trouble over property (Raman HTJH, periods)

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 24.136
source_views.view: Little happiness from the mother; daily losses concerning land, vehicles and houses.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XVI 'Results of the Lord of the Twelfth House being Posited in Different Houses'
source_views.view: Early loss of the mother (traditional), mental restlessness, enmity of relatives, living abroad, an ordinary house and trouble with landlords; well placed, these are largely mitigated; a strong Venus gives an often troublesome conveyance.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XVI 'Time of Fructification' (12th-lord periods with the lord of the house occupied)
source_views.view: With the 4th lord: benefics give substantial property and interest in spiritual literature; malefics bring trouble over property and a crisis for the mother.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer, '12th House' chapter, 'The ruler of the 12th house placed in the' houses
source_views.view: A moksha lord in a moksha house: strong spiritual nature; little happiness from the mother, few comforts and assets, car problems, rents out houses; career changes as the 12th lord aspects the 10th.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri) 16.30
source_views.view: Note the bhava occupied by the 12th lord and the bhava owned by any planet in the 12th: loss of things connected with those bhavas should be predicted.

disagreements: BPHS, Raman and Braha agree on losses and distance from the mother; Raman adds living abroad and Braha a spiritual pull.
phrasing_guidance: Suggest home life may involve moves or distance from the birthplace and that property needs careful handling. No claims about the mother's health.

summary: The lord of expenditure in the house of children and learning: BPHS speaks of setbacks in education and children-related matters, spending on children and a pull towards pilgrimage.
common_outcomes: losses regarding children and education; expenses for children; pilgrimage (BPHS 24.137)
difficulty having children or unhappiness from them (Raman HTJH; Braha); traditional, never predict
religious-minded; undertakes pilgrimages (Raman HTJH)
mental unrest, losses from investments, trouble with exams (Braha)
rare_outcomes: BPHS 24.137 includes loss of children; never use as a prediction
BPHS 23.2: the Moon as 12th lord in the 5th, 9th or 11th is singled out (result implied; Leo lagna case)
crops fail if one takes up agriculture (Raman HTJH)
an ascetic or spiritual child (Braha)
strengtheners: benefic association, own sign or exaltation (BPHS 23.1)
weakeners_or_cancellations: malefics afflicting the 12th lord: trouble on account of children (Raman HTJH, periods)
lagna_or_context_notes: For Gemini lagna Venus (5th+12th) and Sagittarius lagna Mars (5th+12th) are in their own signs here. Frawley (p. 159) calls Venus for Gemini very auspicious, giving mainly 5th-house results, and his mulatrikona rule points the same way for Mars (Aries, the 5th) for Sagittarius.

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 24.137
source_views.view: Loss regarding children and education, expenses for the son, inclination to pilgrimage.

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 23.2
source_views.view: Moon as 12th lord in the 9th, 11th or 5th is singled out for a result.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XVI 'Results of the Lord of the Twelfth House being Posited in Different Houses'
source_views.view: Difficulty begetting children or unhappiness from them; religious-minded, undertakes pilgrimages; weak-minded at times; crops fail in agriculture.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XVI 'Time of Fructification' (12th-lord periods with the lord of the house occupied)
source_views.view: With the 5th lord: progeny in the period but mental strain and loss of friends; malefics bring trouble on account of children.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer, '12th House' chapter, 'The ruler of the 12th house placed in the' houses
source_views.view: Few children or little happiness from them, an ascetic or spiritual child, no peace of mind, losses from investments, trouble with exams, unhappy love affairs.

source_views.source: David Frawley, The Astrology of the Seers, ch. 'The Houses: The Domains of Planetary Action', 'Dual House Rulership', pp. 159-160
source_views.view: The 12th lordship mainly gives the effect of the other house the planet rules (Venus as 5th+12th lord for Gemini is very auspicious); its negative effect shows most when the other house is also malefic (Saturn as 11th+12th lord for Pisces is very inauspicious). The lagna lord is always generally auspicious despite a second malefic lordship.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri) 16.30
source_views.view: Note the bhava occupied by the 12th lord and the bhava owned by any planet in the 12th: loss of things connected with those bhavas should be predicted.

disagreements: None on the core; BPHS, Raman and Braha are negative on children and peace of mind, with pilgrimage as the shared positive.
phrasing_guidance: Talk about investment in children and education and a spiritual bent. Never predict loss of children or fertility problems.

summary: A dusthana lord in another dusthana: Vimala yoga in Phaladeepika and a Viparita Raja yoga in Uttara Kalamrita and Rath, with Raman giving happiness and victory over enemies, while BPHS 24.138 gives harsh character lines and Braha is mixed.
common_outcomes: Vimala yoga: spends little, saves much, kind, happy, independent, respectable (Phaladeepika 6.69)
happy, prosperous, healthy; vanquishes enemies (Raman HTJH); defeats enemies and competitors, debts and expenses decrease (Braha)
litigation that ends in one's favour (Raman HTJH)
good for moksha, as the 12th lord aspects its own house (Braha)
rare_outcomes: BPHS 24.138: conflict with kin, anger, unhappiness and attraction to others' spouses; traditional view, conflicts with Phaladeepika
Phaladeepika 6.32-33: an exchange of the 6th and 12th lords forms a Dainya yoga, which is unfavourable; differs from simple placement
Uttara Kalamrita 4.22: with the 6th and 8th lords also in dusthanas and connected only among themselves, a renowned and wealthy person of great power
with the 6th lord: a joyous period, fortune, wealth and a noble spouse (Raman HTJH, periods)
malefics afflicting the 12th lord: unscrupulous and ill-tempered (Raman HTJH); traditional

by_area.career: Respectable occupation (Phaladeepika 6.69); Braha instead gives bad jobs and problems with subordinates.
by_area.finance: Spends little, saves much (Phaladeepika 6.69); prosperous (Raman HTJH); debts and expenses decrease (Braha).
by_area.relationships: BPHS warns of friction with relatives.

strengtheners: the 6th and 8th lords also in dusthanas and connected (Uttara Kalamrita 4.22); with a dusthana lord or natural malefic, Vipareeta Raja yoga (Rath Crux 15.10)
joined with the 6th lord (Raman HTJH, periods); related to a well-placed 6th lord: fortunate (Raman HTJH, general combinations)
aaps.space (via summary) ties Vimala to the 12th lord in the 6th or 8th with malefic association
weakeners_or_cancellations: exchange with the 6th lord (Dainya yoga, Phaladeepika 6.32-33)
lagna_or_context_notes: For Aries (Jupiter, 9th+12th) the lord goes to Virgo; for Libra (Mercury, 9th+12th) to Pisces, its debilitation sign; for Aquarius Saturn (1st+12th) to Cancer. Frawley (pp. 159-160) says a 12th lordship mainly gives the other house's results, so for these lagnas the 9th or 1st lordship carries the weight. The pure 12th lords are the Moon for Leo and the Sun for Virgo.

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 24.138
source_views.view: Hostility with kin, anger, unhappiness, sinful tendencies, attraction to others' spouses.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika 6.57, 6.69 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri)
source_views.view: 12th lord in the 6th, 8th or 12th: Vimala yoga; spends little, saves much, kind, happy, independent, respectable occupation, known for good qualities.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika 6.32-33 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri)
source_views.view: Exchanges of the 12th lord with the 6th or 8th lords form Dainya yogas with unfavourable results.

source_views.source: aaps.space, Vimala Yog (via summary of Phaladeepika)
source_views.view: Vimala forms when the 12th lord is in the 6th or 8th with malefic association; frugal, happy, independent, respectable profession.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XVI 'Results of the Lord of the Twelfth House being Posited in Different Houses'
source_views.view: Happy and prosperous, long-lived, comfortable, healthy and handsome, vanquishes enemies; litigation ends in his favour; afflicted by malefics, unscrupulous and ill-tempered.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XVI 'Time of Fructification' (12th-lord periods with the lord of the house occupied)
source_views.view: With the 6th lord: the 12th lord's period is full of festivities, fortune, wealth, a noble wife; combined with the 8th lord, political power and fame.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer, '12th House' chapter, 'The ruler of the 12th house placed in the' houses
source_views.view: Unhealthy, bad jobs, problems with subordinates; defeats enemies and competitors; good for moksha as the 12th lord aspects its own house; decreases debts and expenses.

source_views.source: Uttara Kalamrita (Kalidasa; tr. S.S. Sareen) Kanda IV, sloka 22
source_views.view: If the 8th lord is in the 12th or 6th, the 6th lord in the 8th or 12th, and the 12th lord in the 8th or 6th, and these lords are connected among themselves and free of links with other planets, the native will be a great king, renowned and wealthy.

source_views.source: Sanjay Rath, Crux of Vedic Astrology: Timing of Events, 15.10 (the twelfth lord)
source_views.view: The 12th lord causes losses and grief to the house it occupies (in the 1st, loss of health; in the 2nd, loss of wealth). In a dusthana, especially with a dusthana lord or natural malefic, it causes Vipareeta Raja yoga; joined with a natural benefic or yogakaraka it gives Raja yoga in its period if linked to the 10th in the dasamsa.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XVI 'General Combinations'
source_views.view: 12th lord in benefic vargas: wealth spent in honourable, approved ways; with a malefic, debilitated or combust planet: spending in questionable ways. Exalted or in a friendly sign: generous; related to a well-placed 6th lord: fortunate.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri) 16.30
source_views.view: Note the bhava occupied by the 12th lord and the bhava owned by any planet in the 12th: loss of things connected with those bhavas should be predicted.

disagreements: Sharp: BPHS 24.138 is harsh, while Phaladeepika's Vimala, Uttara Kalamrita 4.22, Raman and Rath are favourable; Braha is mixed (enemies defeated and debts reduced, but poor health and jobs). Sources also disagree on Vimala's houses (6th/8th only, or 6th/8th/12th).
phrasing_guidance: Lead with the Vimala reading (discipline with money, independence, good name). Present BPHS's character lines only as a minority traditional view; never call the person sinful or unfaithful.

summary: The lord of expenditure in the house of marriage: BPHS, Raman and Braha see constant spouse-related expenses and limited marital happiness, with Raman adding separation, later asceticism, or a spouse living abroad.
common_outcomes: constant expenses through the spouse; little marital happiness (BPHS 24.139; Braha)
a spouse from a modest family; possible separation (Raman HTJH)
a turn to asceticism later in life (Raman HTJH); possible ascetic nature (Braha)
problematic or unsuccessful partnerships (Braha)
rare_outcomes: BPHS 24.139 also mentions lack of strength and learning (traditional)
with the 7th lord: the wife may live abroad; benefic aspects bring money and a crisis survived (Raman HTJH, periods)
Rath gives the converse case, the 7th lord in the 12th, as a spouse from a poor family (Crux 15.10)

by_area.finance: Debts and expenses on account of the spouse (BPHS 24.139; Braha).
by_area.relationships: Marriage needs care; separation or a spouse living abroad are traditional themes (Raman HTJH).

strengtheners: benefic association, own sign or exaltation (BPHS 23.1)
benefics aspecting the 12th lord (Raman HTJH, periods)
weakeners_or_cancellations: malefics afflicting the 7th and the 12th lord (Raman HTJH, periods)

summary: A dusthana lord in another dusthana: Vimala yoga in Phaladeepika, a Viparita Raja yoga in Uttara Kalamrita, and unusually favourable in BPHS and Raman too (steady gains, wealth, legacies, pleasant speech); Braha is mixed.
common_outcomes: steady gains, pleasant speech and good qualities (BPHS 24.140)
rich and celebrated, a luxurious life; gains through legacies (Raman HTJH)
interest in the occult; righteous, famous, a gentle speaker (Raman HTJH)
frugality and independence (Phaladeepika 6.69); a strong spiritual nature (Braha)
rare_outcomes: BPHS 24.140 mentions a medium lifespan; do not use as a longevity claim
Phaladeepika 6.32-33: exchange of 8th and 12th lords forms a Dainya yoga, unfavourable
Uttara Kalamrita 4.79: if the 8th and 12th lords are associated or exchanged, the 8th lord gives good results and the 12th lord fortune
with the 8th lord: luck with some trouble, slow but successful ventures, money and authority in the period (Raman HTJH, periods)
no benefits from a partner's wealth or insurance (Braha)

by_area.personality: Pleasant-spoken and virtuous (BPHS 24.140; Raman HTJH); independent (Phaladeepika 6.69).
by_area.finance: Steady gains (BPHS 24.140); rich, with legacies (Raman HTJH); no benefit from a partner's wealth or insurance (Braha).
by_area.spirituality: Occult interests and devotion to Vishnu (Raman HTJH); desire for final liberation (Braha).

strengtheners: the 6th and 8th lords also in dusthanas and connected (Uttara Kalamrita 4.22); with a dusthana lord or natural malefic, Vipareeta Raja yoga (Rath Crux 15.10)

malefic affliction of the 12th lord (Raman HTJH, general combinations)
lagna_or_context_notes: For Aquarius lagna Saturn (1st+12th) goes to Virgo; for Capricorn Jupiter (3rd+12th) goes to Leo. Frawley (pp. 159-160): the lagna lordship is always generally auspicious and a 12th lordship mainly gives the other house's results. The pure 12th lords are the Moon for Leo and the Sun for Virgo.

source_views.source: Sanjay Rath, Crux of Vedic Astrology: Timing of Events, 15.10 (the twelfth lord)

In a dusthana, especially with a dusthana lord or natural malefic, it causes Vipareeta Raja yoga; joined with a natural benefic or yogakaraka it gives Raja yoga in its period if linked to the 10th in the dasamsa.

summary: The lord of loss in the house of dharma and teachers: BPHS and Braha warn of little faith, friction with teachers and a spoiled house of fortune, while Raman gives residence and prosperity abroad.

residence abroad and prosperity; property in foreign lands (Raman HTJH)
honest, generous and large-hearted (Raman HTJH)
little happiness from the father; little faith or gain from gurus (Braha)
comfortable beds and a peaceful afterlife (Braha)

BPHS 20.19: exchange of 9th and 12th lords is among harsh father-related combinations; traditional only
with the 9th lord: a steady career; benefics aspecting the 9th give piety but modest material prosperity (Raman HTJH, periods)

by_area.relationships: Friction even with friends (BPHS 24.141); Raman adds dislike of spouse, friends and preceptor.
by_area.family: Little happiness from the father (Raman HTJH; Braha).

spends on religious and righteous purposes (Raman HTJH)
good eyesight and bed pleasures (Raman HTJH; Braha)

by_area.spirituality: Moksha orientation (BPHS 23.10; Braha); seeks the company of holy people (Raman HTJH, periods).
